title: Ligation Protocol with T4 DNA Ligase
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7khhkt6

steps.title: Prepare T4 DNA Ligase Buffer
steps.instruction: Thaw the T4 DNA Ligase Buffer and resuspend at room temperature.

steps.title: Set up Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the following reaction components in a microcentrifuge tube on ice, adding the T4 DNA Ligase last to reach a total volume of 20 μl:

substeps.instruction: Add 2 μl T4 DNA Ligase Buffer (10X)
Add 50 ng (0.020 pmol) Vector DNA (4 kb)
Add 37.5 ng (0.060 pmol) Insert DNA (1 kb)
Add nuclease-free water to reach 20 μl

steps.title: Mix Reaction
steps.instruction: Gently mix the reaction by pipetting up and down and centrifuge briefly in a microfuge.

steps.title: Incubate Ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction based on the DNA end type:

substeps.instruction: For cohesive (sticky) ends: incubate at 16ºC overnight or room temperature for 10 minutes
For blunt ends or single base overhangs: incubate at 16ºC overnight or room temperature for 2 hours

steps.title: Heat Inactivate Ligase
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction at 65ºC for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Chill and Transform
steps.instruction: Chill the reaction on ice and transform 1-5 μL of the mixture into 50 μL competent cells.
